name: temple_of_malady_scry_one_bottom
notes: P2b2dfac54f G4. Printed: 'This land enters tapped. When this land enters, scry 1.' The real land drop: the Temple enters tapped and its scry looks at ONE card. The pack answers bottom to every scry ask it might get: only the top card (Library 5) goes to the bottom, the rest keep their order. Seat 0's life is unchanged (no gain on this land).
